cohort_rules.Identity/grain: Every query declares grain and source-qualified entity keys. Repeated run attachments and linked imported evaluation requests are unioned by identity. Different sources with the same local id remain distinct. Task and goal contributions never create a second copy of billable usage.
cohort_rules.Activity windows: UTC [from,to), filter completed request/tool/query observations by qualified completion timestamp; interval metrics clip to the window in a comparable clock domain. Invalid or absent clocks are excluded with reason, never silently coerced.
cohort_rules.Outcome cohorts: Select eligible logical tasks/runs by accepted terminal time in [from,to), scoped source/task/case/difficulty/workflow/model/config conditions. Pending outcomes are right-censored and reported separately. Cost-per-outcome includes ALL attempts of those selected entities, even attempts before the window. Do not truncate numerator to activity-window spend.
cohort_rules.Snapshots: Inventory/status counts are as_of snapshots, not event-count windows. All pages and drilldown use the same immutable input-manifest digest and source generation; changed snapshots cause explicit stale-cursor refusal or a new query.
cohort_rules.Missingness: Eligible, covered, excluded and unavailable counts are field-specific. A capable producer fixture must yield observed metrics; unavailable is valid only for a recorded capability/data-loss reason. Unknown eligible denominator makes coverage unknown; no null-to-zero default.
cohort_rules.Quality and distributions: Pool numerators and denominators rather than average rates. Nearest-rank quantiles use completed covered samples with n and outliers visible; no silent outlier removal. Active samples are censored, not zero-duration. Comparable case/scorer/config/model/semantics and quality floor required for improvement claims.
cohort_rules.Session-only accounting: If a host exposes only a cumulative session/native estimate, retain a distinct session observation with baseline/delta and coverage. Never invent leaf request ids, exact per-task allocation or complete request denominators. Where final request observations also exist, choose one authoritative accounting granularity to avoid overlap.
